messages:
Leah C: Found a mismatch in the migration guide examples after today's deploy. The TypeScript quickstart is v2-correct but Python examples still use `model_name` and show a curl to /v1/embeddings.
Tom R: Oof. File path?
Leah C: docs/migration.md and quickstarts/embeddings.md.
Zoe W: Paste the python snippet?
Leah C: ```python
# problematic snippet
resp = client.generate(model_name=\"redwood-mini\", prompt=\"hello\")
print(resp.output_text)
```
Tom R: I'll open a tiny PR to normalize to `model`, update curl to /v2/embeddings, and add a short migration checklist. PR 2007: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2007
docs-bot: lint: examples -> deprecated param 'model_name' detected.
Zoe W: Can we include a short, clearly-labeled "temporary compatibility shim" for Python and TS so customers have a stopgap? Make sure to mark "not for production" and include deprecation timeline.
Tom R: Added shims to PR and a 5-day grace note per runtime. Preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/2007
preview-bot: preview available; snippet-runner executed against mocks.
Leah C: Reviewed and left one wording nit. Please stress the shim is a migration aid only.
Tom R: Updated wording and merged after CI. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
